style: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium polished soft glossy 3D miniature illustration, charming clean product diorama. One smooth magenta-pink to deep violet gradient sphere with soft horizontal bands and a thin glowing tilted orbit ring. Brand palette ONLY #12001E #2C0A3E #3C096C #BB88EB #E0BEFF #F1E2FF #E91E7A #F72585 and white highlights. No blue green orange yellow. Square 1024x1024, centered planet sphere diameter 62% of frame, entire diorama and orbit inside frame with generous margin. Camera slightly above equator, key light upper left, pink rim lower right, soft bloom, rounded glossy materials, high-end animated-film miniature quality, not photorealistic, not flat clipart. Actual transparent background. No text letters numbers logos trademarks watermarks. Few large readable props, clear at 120px.
anchorSubject: Two original generic blocky voxel adventurers, pixel-block tree, miniature block arena and gamepad satellite.

planetSubjects.web: Tiny glowing blank browser windows like lit miniature website houses across surface, three houses and two connection arcs.
planetSubjects.wordpress: Two orbiting puzzle-piece plugins, stacked blank theme cards, a fountain pen nib and blank blog pages on surface. No W or logo.
planetSubjects.managed: Two small friendly maintenance robots holding wrenches, a tiny crane tending two server racks, heart-shaped care satellite.
planetSubjects.reseller: Ring of four tiny storefront shops on planet surface and three small client moons in orderly formation.
planetSubjects.builder: Two miniature cranes stacking blank header blocks, image tiles and blank text strips into one large web page on surface.
planetSubjects.mail: Three large envelopes flying along orbit ring and a small rounded mailbox on upper surface.
planetSubjects.email-security: Clear translucent lilac shield dome over planet, three envelopes protected inside, two small pink spam bugs bouncing off outside dome.
planetSubjects.vps: Three miniature server racks standing on surface with tiny pink LED lights, three cube-shaped software containers.
planetSubjects.dedicated: One large single server tower standing prominently on upper surface like a monument with lilac status lights.
planetSubjects.colo: Orbital docking station carrying two server racks, small generic cargo space shuttle docking to it above sphere.
planetSubjects.ddos: Strong two-layer transparent lilac force field surrounds sphere; four small violet meteors hitting outside and bursting harmlessly into pink sparks.
planetSubjects.database: Three glowing database cylinders composed of neatly stacked discs, built like small towers on upper surface.
planetSubjects.developer: Tiny open laptop and two terminal screens showing only abstract luminous lines with NO letters, a branching git-like tree of light.
planetSubjects.ssl: One prominent closed padlock standing on upper surface, orbit ring curves like a closed lock shackle.
planetSubjects.domains: Three blank direction-arrow signposts, blank address tags hanging on strings, routing light beams to three small moons.
planetSubjects.datacenter: Small datacenter building complex of two rounded buildings, visible cooling units and tidy power lines on surface.
planetSubjects.ai: Small friendly rounded assistant robot with luminous empty chat bubble and neural network of lilac sparkling connected nodes.
planetSubjects.monitoring: Large miniature radar dish on upper surface, orbit ring incorporates a distinct heartbeat pulse zigzag waveform.
planetSubjects.backups: Little vault safe on surface with round door, three smaller translucent ghost copies of sphere in a row like snapshots.
planetSubjects.support: Small lighthouse sending a soft lilac pink beam, headset-shaped satellite orbiting. Warm welcoming feeling within pink lilac palette only.
planetSubjects.company: Cosy rounded headquarters building on calm home planet with one blank lilac flag, clean welcoming windows.
planetSubjects.knowledge: Stacks of books and tiny library building on surface with two floating blank guide cards.
planetSubjects.legal: Small elegant balance scale and sealed blank document scroll on calm upper surface.

backgroundSubjects.bg-nebula: Soft gently rounded violet and pink nebula clouds confined mostly to lower right and outer edges, a few tiny distant stylized banded planets at far edges.
backgroundSubjects.bg-horizon: The curved limb of an enormous smooth glossy pink violet banded planet ONLY along bottom 22% of image, soft glowing lilac atmosphere. Dark empty space above.
backgroundSubjects.bg-deep: Very dark subtle lilac dust, a very small distant glossy pink violet ringed planet only in bottom right corner, planet under 9% of image width.

reference: Client style-reference.png; game used as the shared image reference for all subsequent assets.
